observation.visible_scene: A yellow press head with a short chrome cylindrical piston (banded with a yellow ring at its lower end) sits centered above a yellow platform inside a black chamber framed by yellow-and-black hazard stripes. On the platform lies a transparent block (glass/ice-like) that is already broken: a vertical column of shattered pieces remains directly under the piston, while many clear fragments and a fine dust cloud fill the surrounding air.
visible_changes: The piston and the yellow platform stay at essentially fixed positions relative to the frame throughout the excerpt; the chrome cylinder's height above the platform does not visibly change.

The airborne transparent fragments move outward and downward over time (e.g., a left-side shard drifts from center-left toward the left edge and lower, a right-side shard moves toward the right edge and down), consistent with pieces already in flight after a prior break.
Individual shards rotate and tumble as they travel, and the densest part of the dust cloud slowly thins and settles toward the platform.
The column of larger broken pieces directly beneath the yellow ring remains roughly in place, only shifting slightly as smaller bits fall away.
The hazard-striped frame and background edges show at most minor positional drift, indicating the camera is largely static rather than panning.
outside_clip_unknowns: The initial contact/impact that shattered the block (the shattering is already underway at t=0).
Whether the press piston descends further or lifts after this segment.
The final resting position of the fragments once all motion ceases.
uncertain_details: Exact material of the transparent object (glass vs ice vs acrylic) cannot be confirmed.
Whether the small bright shapes on the chrome cylinder are reflections of nearby shards or shards passing in front of it.
Any very slight piston motion vs. camera zoom/drift is within the noise of the sampled frames and cannot be separated confidently.
